goals: Provide a single, consistent opt-in flag (`--yolo`) across all agent-invoking `nvst` commands.
When `--yolo` is set, every `invokeAgent` call passes the provider's bypass flags regardless of `interactive` mode.

userStories.title: Developer runs any nvst command with `--yolo` to suppress agent permission prompts
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to append `--yolo` to any `nvst` command that invokes an agent so that the agent never stops to ask for file-read/write permissions during its work, even when running in interactive (interview) mode.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `--yolo` option is declared on all eight agent-invoking commands in `src/cli.ts`:
Each command handler receives `yolo: boolean` and forwards it to `invokeAgent` via `AgentInvokeOptions`.
`AgentInvokeOptions` in `src/agent.ts` exposes an optional `yolo?: boolean` field (default `false`).
When `--yolo` is **not** set, spawned args are identical to the current behavior (no regression).
`bun tsc --noEmit` (typecheck) passes with no new errors.

functionalRequirements.description: All eight agent-invoking subcommands in `src/cli.ts` must declare `.option("--yolo", "Invoke agent with bypass-permissions flags (suppresses agent permission prompts)")`.
`yolo: boolean` must be threaded from each command's parsed opts down through its handler options interface (e.g., `IdeateOptions`, `DefineRequirementOptions`) to the `invokeAgentFn` call site.
`invokeAgent` must respect `yolo` in the interactive-mode branches for **Codex** and **Copilot** by including the same bypass args that those providers already use in non-interactive mode.
The `--yolo` flag is independent of `--force`; they may be combined.
No new runtime dependencies may be added.
